gem|skill gem]] which causes nearby enemies to take more [[physical damage]]. The effect of the aura increases the longer an enemy stays within the aura's radius. [[File:Pride skill screenshot.png|thumb|right|A [[Marauder]] with the default Pride aura visual effect]] ==Skill functions and interactions== Because Pride only affects enemies, it can't be supported by {{il|Generosity Support}}. Pride has base radius of 4 metres, the same as most other aura skills.{{cite web | author = Community_Team | date = May 27, 2021 | title = Game Mechanics Q&A Answer Part 2 | url = https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/3130696 | publisher = Official Path of Exile Forums | accessdate = May 29, 2021 }} ==Gem level progression== {{Skill progression |c1_abbr = Physical

{{Modifier table |q_tables = mod_stats |q_join = mods._pageID=mod_stats._pageID |q_where=mod_stats.id LIKE "%Pride%" AND mods.generation_type IN (28, 29) |stat_text=1 |spawn_weights=1 |level=1 |generation_type=1 |q_orderBy = mods.id ASC }}
===Legacy mods=== {{Modifier table |q_tables = mod_stats, mod_spawn_weights |q_join = mods._pageID=mod_stats._pageID, mods._pageID=mod_spawn_weights._pageID |q_where = mod_stats.id LIKE "%Pride%" AND mods.generation_type NOT IN (28, 29) |q_having = SUM(mod_spawn_weights.value) = 0 |q_groupBy = mod_spawn_weights._pageID |stat_text=1 |level=1 |spawn_weights=1 }} These {{c|mod|Mana Reservation Efficiency}} mods function the same as the non-legacy counterpart. But the mod was reworked with the [[version 3.16.0]] reservation rework. The stored mod values show in the official trade site/in-game are implemented in opposite sign between legacy and non-legacy mods. {{Alternate skill effect list|query= items.class_id="Microtransaction" AND cosmetic_items.cosmetic_type LIKE "Skill Gem Effect" AND ( BINARY items.name LIKE "%Pride%" OR BINARY items.description LIKE "%Pride%" OR items.description LIKE "%your aura%" OR BINARY items.name LIKE "Invisible Buff Effect" ) }} ==Monster versions== [[Sevet Tetherein]] and [[Perfect Blood Demon]] use their own variant of Pride aura. While Pride shares the same interface icon with Medium/Large [[Physical Damage Aura]], they behave differently. ==Version history== {{Version history table header}} {{Version history table row|3.13.0| * Divergent Pride now causes nearby enemies to have -0.1% to physical damage reduction per 1% gem quality (from 0.5% per 1% gem quality). }} {{Version history table row|3.12.0| * Now has alternative gem quality. }} {{Version history table row|3.7.4| * Added Labyrinth Enchantments }} {{Version history table row|3.7.0| * Pride has been added to the game. }} {{Version history table end}} ==References== {{reflist}} {{Navbox Skills}}
